test_title: PYST 17: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. E sits to the immediate right of D. G sits second to the left of E. B sits third to the right of E. A is the immediate neighbour of C and B. How many people sit between F and C when counted from the left of F?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. E sits to the immediate right of D.

2. G sits second to the left of E.

3. B sits third to the right of E.

4. A is the immediate neighbour of C and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b57cd5a7b85b6d3276533ece86dbfcfe39e67fbeaf170fe9cae136c4967dd807.png] 

F, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e8c2445c0f8119bbf001a139b77f6b7ef6f5e00d0477d24c4c3d15aced898a0.png] 

Thus, two people sit between F and C when counted from the left of F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
